tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: terminal panes, code blocks, the area behind the page shell.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-black with a faint green cast, never pure #000.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panels, cards, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows, active tab, the lowest ground any text sits on.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected rows and text selection. ink and neon both read on it (8.6:1, 7.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between surfaces. Decorative in Dark; in High contrast it reaches 5:1 so surfaces are set apart by borders, not shade alone.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes): 3:1 or more on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text: soft phosphor white. 11:1 or more on bg-000 to bg-300. The default for every paragraph.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and emphasised words on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, placeholders, comments in code. 7.5:1 or more on bg-000 to bg-200, 6.8:1 on bg-300 (Dark); 10.8:1 or more (High contrast).

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: The brand green from the profile pictures. Accents only: links, the prompt sign, cursor, focus ring, primary button fill, active indicators, success. Never for paragraphs. 9.6:1 or more on bg-000 to bg-300. Light: #156b08, a deep phosphor green that keeps 5.3:1 or more as text; the bright #3be81a is too pale on paper.

tokens.name: neon-soft
tokens.usage: Link hover and visited-free highlight text; a calmer green for longer accent runs (12:1 or more on all grounds).

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a neon fill (primary button). 11.8:1. Light: white on the deep green (6.7:1).

tokens.name: bot
tokens.usage: Bot red-orange from the bot avatar's keys, kept exact. Fills, icons, borders and badges for anything said or done by a bot, and errors/danger. For TEXT use bot-text.

tokens.name: bot-text
tokens.usage: Bot and error TEXT on every ground: 5.6:1 or more on bg-000 to bg-300 (Dark), 7.7:1 or more (High contrast).

tokens.name: on-bot
tokens.usage: Text on a bot fill (destructive button, bot badge). 5.5:1. Light: white (5.3:1).

tokens.name: py-yellow
tokens.usage: Python yellow from the header. Warnings, Python-related tags, highlighted search matches. 11:1 or more on all grounds. Light: #7a5c00 (dark ochre) so warnings stay readable on paper.

tokens.name: py-blue
tokens.usage: Python blue from the header, kept exact. Info fills, icons, borders, Python tags. For TEXT use py-blue-text.

tokens.name: py-blue-text
tokens.usage: Info and secondary-link TEXT on every ground: 6:1 or more (Dark), 9:1 or more (High contrast).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Tint of every glass surface (Glass, NavBar, Toolbar, Sidebar, Dock, Menu, Toast, Dialog). 80% opaque: ink keeps 6.4:1 or more even over a pure white or neon area behind (7.7:1 typical); 94% in High contrast. Light: 85% white; ink keeps 11:1 even over black content behind.

tokens.name: glass-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of glass buttons.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim and inner separators of glass surfaces. Decorative in Dark; a real 3:1 boundary in High contrast.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top-down specular highlight that gives glass its liquid look. Off in High contrast.

tokens.name: hover-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill of rows and links on glass (nav links, sidebar items, window controls, dock tiles).

tokens.name: hover-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Resting fill of dock tiles and stronger hover.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: field-on-glass
tokens.usage: Background of a search field sitting on glass.

tokens.name: wall-dot
tokens.usage: Dot grid of the ck-wall backdrop.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and hero lines. One per page.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, group labels inside panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Readable first. The green is a signal, not a wallpaper.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines at 72 characters or fewer.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, help text, table cells in dense views.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal output, on bg-000.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, tags, button text, table headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), gaps inside a row of controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding, gaps between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Terminal panes, code blocks, tables, the page shell.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Solid content containers: cards, alerts. The largest radius for anything that is not glass.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass that floats close to content: menus, toasts, tooltips, sidebar items, dock tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large glass: windows, dialogs, command palette, floating sidebar, dock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Glass bars and controls: NavBar, Toolbar, SegmentedControl, glass buttons, search fields, switches, avatars.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a solid 2px neon ring, 9.6:1 or more on every ground. High contrast: 3px.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Phosphor glow. Only on the active/primary element of a view (primary button hover, live cursor). Never on text blocks. Off in High contrast.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Lift and inner top light of glass surfaces. The only drop shadow in the system.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur of every glass surface (with saturate 140%).
